assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit: the canonical V2 reconstruction model MHA_SP2_TODOROKI_SHOTO_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md (read in full, with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its SH-SUP-01 to SH-SUP-03 sections admit), and the Todoroki Shoto sections of the Class 1-A character-state ledger, the relationship-state ledger, the Japanese vocabulary ledger and the character-model readiness index, each read for every Shoto entry together with its front matter and current admissibility corrections. dimensions.note: The model states a durable goal (become a hero by his own choice), an early substitution of paternal negation for a positive self-account (SH01: V04:p096-103, 完全否定), an ideal self that protects without being an instrument of paternal ambition, and a feared self made behaviorally specific in V13: reproducing Endeavor's narrow gaze (V13:p059-074, 嫌だったモンに 自分がなっていた). Repeated decision rules are located: separate useful technique from ownership (V22:p060-062, V26:p013-016); act on urgent danger without settled feeling (V30:p090-115, V38:p187-203); acknowledge causation while refusing fatalism (V31:p138-141, V36:p007-038). Not A: SH-V01 is a single retrospective, nonblind probe whose emotional-trajectory axis is only partial and whose exact topic was unpredicted, the model has eight atoms, and its affect is often unverbalized. Not C: goal, feared self and policies are explicit, state-separated and repeated across V04-V42.

The model separates five snapshots (isolated early student, after the Sports Festival, license failure and renewed training, Toya revelation and final war, V42 and adulthood). The class ledger gives dated deltas from V02 and V03 through V42, and the readiness index records the trajectory from emerging (V02-V03) through moderate (V04) and strong (held by V13) to specialist_ready (V30). Transitions are located: fire use without reconciliation (V05:p098-100), resentment named as a hazard (V13), professional use of Endeavor (V26), family causation shared but unequal (V31), Phosphor (V36), the food question (V42:p062-064) and adult reflection (V42:p166-168). Not A: no Shoto entry covers V01, V12, V14-V17, V19, V24, V27-V28, V32-V33 or V40-V41, and the adult interval is undated beyond the altar reference. Not C: state changes are explicit and the model forbids moving later states earlier.

The vocabulary ledger and the deltas locate first person 俺 with childhood 僕 in the V05 memory, rough contracted forms toward Endeavor and peers (クソ親父 V03:p144-145; そんな屑の道具にはならねえ V04:p100-101; なりてえもんちゃんと見ろ V06:p189; 勝手にしろよ V18:p173; 親父!!! 来るぞ!! 後にしてくれ!!! V30), terse but exact autobiographical disclosure (V04:p092-105), urgent command, and a polite reflective register to Rei (たくさん話すと 衝突することも あります。 / 俺も そうなりたいです。 V39:p051). It also locates V36's 交わるよ 無理にでも and the V42 lines 自分でなりてえように (p066) and なりたい自分以外にも (p168). The model gives register rules: compact and literal, sharpening under urgency, distancing to Endeavor, not affectless, no polite endings appended mechanically. SH-V01 found speech supported, though the topic was unpredicted. Not A: the ledger calls its strings retrieval aids that must be rechecked on the page; there are few extended exchanges and almost no ordinary-life speech. Not C: there are many located strings, and the register contrasts are tied to interlocutor and state.

Located ordinary acts are scattered: an awkward hospital joke (V07:p079-080), a deadpan interview (V25), the imagined hot udon with Toya (V35:p041-057), the soba question and shared preference (V42:p062-064), adult plans for tableware craft (V42:p166-168), and the supplemental SH-SUP-02 and SH-SUP-03 facts (annual child-facing ice play, individualized fan attention, the cold-soba profile fact, the Bakugo lamp report). Not C: the supplemental items are profile facts and author comments rather than enacted scenes, the food acts are framed by family repair, and the model itself says readiness is narrower for unseen domestic routine and that adult interests provide no extensive private biography. Not E: there are more independent ordinary occasions than a single local scene.

The partner table gives conditional policies for Endeavor (antagonistic boundary, then selective professional learning with unresolved judgment: V05:p098-100, V18:p173, V21:p054-074, V22:p060-062, V26:p013-016), Rei (V05:p080-082, p180-184; V39:p047-062), Toya (V30:p118-153; V35:p041-057; V36:p007-038; V42:p062-064), Midoriya (V04-V05, V30), Iida and Momo (V06:p184-189; V08:p019-022; V36:p039-056; V38-V39 transport), and Inasa (V13:p057-074; V18). The relationship ledger records each as a separately dated state. Not A: direct exchanges with Rei, Natsuo and Fuyumi are thin, Bakugo is reached through V05, V09 coordination and a supplemental gift report, and adult relationships are OPEN. Not C: the policies are explicit, located and partner-specific.

Inner states are reached mainly through his own located disclosures and reflections: the V04 private history to Midoriya; V05:p098-100 (for an instant he forgot his father) and p139-157 (lost certainty, to Bakugo); V13:p059-074 self-diagnosis; V26:p044-047 (does not know what to think of his father); V35:p041-057 (does not know what Toya likes); V39:p051 (wants to become like friends who cry for others); V42:p166-168. The model warns that quietness is not lack of feeling. Not A: affect is frequently unverbalized, SH-V01 rated emotional trajectory partial (the effect of the apology is not verbalized), and most access is spoken self-report rather than analyzed thought. Not C: the reflections are repeated, located and state-specific.

Located conflict regimes: overwhelming ice and threat assessment (V02:p073, p172); father-triggered destabilization and self-limitation (V03:p144-145, V04:p164-171); coordinated combat without relational warmth (V09 with Bakugo); resentment-driven failure turned into fire/wind cooperation (V13:p059-109); triage when Endeavor freezes (V30:p090-115); Phosphor and Great Glacial Aegir against Toya (V36:p007-038); accepting transport through exhaustion and doubt (V38:p187-203, V39:p047-062); and an interpersonal policy that collision can produce understanding (V39:p051). Not A: there is no frozen combat or tactical prediction, and the model rejects generic power matchups (no generic 'ice beats fire'). Not C: the triggers and responses are explicit and repeated across school, professional and war settings.

Located moral reasoning: a challenge to the Hosu police framing that saving people is hero work (V07:p065); responsibility for his own professional failure rather than exemption by family history (V13:p071-074); causal responsibility kept with Endeavor while present responsibility is shared (V31:p138-141); family causation acknowledged but not as an inevitability that licenses mass destruction (V36:p007-038); no forgiving on Rei's or Natsuo's behalf (model, SH05-SH08). Not B: what is shown is mostly stated conclusions inside one domain (family causation and forgiveness). The V10-V11 covert-rescue decision is recorded through its coalition and Aizawa's later breach-of-trust judgment, not through Shoto's own weighing. V31 leaves the method of 'stop' OPEN, and civic or abstract dilemmas are absent. Not D: the reasons are explicit, located and consistent across V07-V36.

Only local items: an awkward joke in the V07:p079-080 hospital decompression, literal or deadpan interview behavior (V25), the supplemental author comment qualifying the airhead label (he continues taking words straightforwardly), and the Bakugo lamp report, which the model files under gag and editorial sources (SH-SUP-02, SH-SUP-03). There is no humor policy and no repeated play regime. Not D: the evidence is too thin and largely nonenacted. Not NOT_ASSESSED: located evidence exists and bounds the domain.

The set covers the main arcs from V02 to V42 through dense dated class-ledger deltas and relationship-ledger states, lexical anchors with locators, and a dedicated model of eight atoms, one conditional reconstruction and one probe, with supplemental claims labeled by source class. Not B: fourteen volumes have no Shoto entry, the model is compact, the ledger strings are retrieval aids, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection. Not D: the coverage is continuous across every major arc that features him, and the current admissibility corrections leave Shoto's entries untouched apart from bounding V42:p062-064.

Affirmative located limits with page and state: fire use is not reconciliation (V05:p087 against p098-100); unintegrated resentment caused literal blindness toward Inasa (V13:p070); self-reliance underused Momo's judgment until corrected (V08:p019-022); 勝手にしろよ withholds absolution (V18:p173) and public victory does not compel forgiveness (V21:p054-074); the thermal outcome depended on family cooling and Iida's transport (V39:p047-062); V36's victory was not closure (V37:p183-195); Toya's apology is one directed movement, not family-wide reconciliation (V42:p062-064, admissibility correction); burden over-assignment was corrected by Iida (V36:p039-056). The model's REJECT list (fire use as paternal forgiveness; family duty as equal blame) and the supplemental bounds (Inasa's wish is not reciprocity; the lamp motive is guessed) add more. Not A: some items limit reconstruction claims rather than record contradictions, and none is tested by a frozen prediction. Not C: there are more than six independent, located limits. This is the grade most worth testing for overgrading.

Knowledge gates are explicit: in V03 the family reason is withheld and must not be imported; family causation is disclosed in V04; V20 ends with pride, forgiveness or rejection OPEN; Toya's identity is unknown until V30:p090-115; the method of stopping him is OPEN at V31; Phosphor appears in V36; V36's victory is not final (V37); the altar at V42:p167 implies a later death but does not date it. The model forbids granting the analyst's account of Toya's life to a pre-revelation student and forbids putting adult knowledge of family loss into the V42 hospital encounter. Not A: the adult interval is undated and fourteen volumes lack entries. Not C: the gates are located and enforced by the model and ledgers.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates many real formulations across registers and gives register rules, and SH-V01 found speech qualitatively supported. But the vocabulary ledger calls its strings retrieval aids whose glyphs must be rechecked on the Japanese page, there is no address inventory or sustained ordinary conversation, SH-V01 could not predict the actual topic, and the model says generated dialogue would be illustrative prediction, never attributed quotation. Retrieving located lines is supported; writing new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Shoto's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named snapshot, stated explicitly, with his knowledge of Toya's identity, family history (what he remembers and what he was told) and the current thermal danger fixed for it; later integration, Phosphor and adult reflection are never moved earlier.

The interlocutor is Endeavor, Rei, Toya, Midoriya, Iida, Momo, Inasa, Bakugo, Class 1-A or the public, handled as the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot, with no forgiveness, reconciliation or family-wide repair assumed.

The setting is school training or examination, licensing or remedial work, professional internship or rescue, combat or war, family crisis, or the post-war ordinary approach, with his technical state (refusal, partial integration, regulation, Phosphor) and available support stated.

Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels, keeps family-triggered narrowing and burden over-assignment as live risks, produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named snapshot, stated explicitly: isolated early student (V02-V04), after the Sports Festival (V05-V12), license failure and renewed professional training (V13-V29), Toya revelation and final war (V30-V39), or V42 and adulthood; whether Toya's identity is known, what family history he directly remembers or was told, and the current thermal danger are fixed for that snapshot.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Endeavor, Rei, Toya, Midoriya, Iida, Momo, Inasa, Bakugo, Class 1-A peers or the public, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot; Endeavor's professional and paternal roles stay separate, and each family member's own boundary is preserved.
setting_constraints: School training, examination, licensing or remedial work; professional internship or rescue; combat or war; family crisis; or the post-war ordinary approach
His technical state (right-side-only refusal, partial integration, acquired flame regulation, Phosphor) and available support stated
No forgiveness, family-wide reconciliation or adult private relationship assumed, and no invented domestic routine or romance

scenario_readiness.note: The model's one conditional reconstruction (post-internship Shoto: Endeavor gives useful advice while claiming credit for who Shoto has become; Shoto separates technique from ownership, states a boundary and acts on operational need, with high confidence for the distinction and medium for its sharpness) supports narrow novel scenes. So does SH-V01's V41 to V42 ordinary-approach prediction, supported on four of five axes. The probe is retrospective and nonblind, and only one reconstruction is modeled.

conditions: Setting is a Class 1-A peer exchange, a public or child-facing hero appearance, or a bounded ordinary family approach in a named snapshot.
Literal or sparse responses are read through context and the speaker's actual knowledge, without making him affectless, incapable of irony, or every misunderstanding harmless.
No domestic routine, leisure biography or private adult relationship is invented, and supplemental profile facts constrain without becoming enacted scenes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located peer and public ordinary interaction exists: hospital decompression (V07:p079-080), the corrective repair with Momo (V08:p019-022), the deadpan interview (V25), the food question (V42:p062-064) and the supplemental child-facing ice play and fan attention (SH-SUP-02). There is enough for bounded peer or public scenes, with literal reception read through context, but not for domestic or private adult life.

conditions: The dilemma concerns his own responsibility, family causation, forgiveness or present danger, in a named snapshot after V13 (or after V30 for anything involving Toya).
Asymmetric causal responsibility stays with Endeavor, present responsibility can be shared, and no one's forgiveness is granted on another person's behalf.
Civic, legal or abstract dilemmas, and the lethal or nonlethal method of stopping Toya, are not extrapolated beyond located positions.
scenario_readiness.note: Located reasoning supports bounded responsibility and forgiveness questions: own failure without exemption (V13), unequal causal versus shared present responsibility (V31:p138-141), causation without fatalism (V36:p007-038), and no forgiving on others' behalf. The reasons are mostly stated conclusions within the family-causation domain.
No curated item analyzes romantic interest or behavior, and the model lists private adult relationships as OPEN. This silence is neither evidence of a trait nor of an inability.

conditions: Setting is training, licensing, internship, rescue, combat or adult public service in a named snapshot, with his technical state and available support stated.
Professional use of Endeavor's expertise is not treated as relational reconciliation, and coordination, deference to a stronger plan or accepting help are not treated as submission.
Outcomes that depended on others (family cooling, Iida's transport, coalition support) are not reassigned to his solitary authorship.
scenario_readiness.note: Located professional regimes: the V08 examination repair with Momo, the V10 bounded rescue judgment, the V13 license failure and the V18 remedial course with children, applying the license in public danger (V23:p099-108), the V25-V26 internship and the V26:p071 rescue using acquired flame regulation, the war fronts (V29-V39), and adult public service (V42; SH-SUP-02).

known_limits.statement: Using fire or Endeavor's technique never signals forgiveness or filial reconciliation: V05:p098-100 (he only forgot Endeavor for an instant) against Endeavor's reading at p087, V21:p054-074 (no forgiveness compelled), V22:p060-062 and V26:p013-016 (technical uptake without relational surrender), and SH-SUP-01's separation of learning from forgiving. The model REJECTs fire use as paternal forgiveness.

A family cue can destabilize otherwise controlled behavior and narrow interpersonal perception: V03:p144-145 and V04:p164-171 under the father's gaze, and V13:p059-074, where resentment produced literal blindness toward Inasa and a license failure. Reconstructions must keep this as a live hazard rather than portraying uniform calm.

The decisive actions against Toya depended on others: Great Glacial Aegir in V39:p047-062 acted on a target the family had already been cooling, after Iida's transport, and V36's immediate victory was not closure (V37:p183-195). Results must not be modeled as Shoto's sole authorship or as a generic power matchup.

Shoto's food question and Toya's apology at V42:p062-064 establish one directed movement between two brothers, not family-wide reconciliation, under the relationship ledger's current admissibility correction. Shoto does not forgive on Rei's or Natsuo's behalf, and his willingness to face Toya does not make him culpable for the childhood conditions.

He tends to take sole responsibility for burdens that action produces or that the family shares: the singular 'I have to deal with Toya' at V31:p058-062 becomes collective at p138-141, and his apology to Iida for heat interference is rejected as unnecessary at V36:p039-056. Close peers and family correct this tendency; it is not a stable solitary-hero policy.

Sparse or literal responses are not an inability to understand emotion. He recognizes Iida's resentment (V06:p184-185), discloses an exact private history once he judges it necessary (V04:p092-105), and in V42 seeks the ordinary conversation that combat could not supply. The author comment in SH-SUP-02 qualifies the airhead label without guaranteeing perfect comprehension, so neither affectless nor fully ironic writing is supported.
No Shoto entry in the curated set covers V01, V12, V14-V17, V19, V24, V27-V28, V32-V33 or V40-V41; behavior in those intervals is not established.
The adult interval, the date of Toya's death implied by the V42:p167 altar, future family contact and private adult relationships are OPEN in the model; ordinary domestic routine is unseen.

The one formal probe (SH-V01) is a retrospective, nonblind chronological holdout on a single family-approach scene, with emotional trajectory partial and the topic unpredicted; no frozen prediction tests peer, professional, combat or adult behavior.

Not A: exact affect is frequently unverbalized, SH-V01 rated emotional trajectory partial (the effect of the apology is not verbalized), and most access is spoken self-report rather than analyzed thought. Not C: the reflections are repeated, located, state-specific and tied to decisions. Exact affect stays a limit on use.

Located conflict regimes: overwhelming ice and threat assessment (V02:p073, p172); father-triggered destabilization and self-limitation (V03:p144-145, V04:p164-171); coordinated combat without relational warmth (V09 with Bakugo); resentment-driven failure turned into fire/wind cooperation (V13:p059-109); triage when Endeavor freezes (V30:p090-115); Phosphor and Great Glacial Aegir against Toya (V36:p007-038); accepting transport through exhaustion and doubt (V38:p187-203, V39:p047-062); and an interpersonal policy that collision can produce understanding (V39:p051). Not A: there is no frozen combat or tactical prediction, and the model rejects generic power matchups (no generic 'ice beats fire'). Not C: the triggers and responses are explicit and repeated across school, professional and war settings.

Bounded to responsibility, family causation, forgiveness and the duty to save. The model gives a discriminating moral policy: it separates who caused the family system, who now has capacity to act, and who may decide their own future relation, and the evidence locates choices that apply each part. He refuses family history as an exemption from his own professional failure (V13:p071-074). He keeps causal responsibility with Endeavor while accepting shared present responsibility (V31:p138-141). He acknowledges causation while rejecting the fatalistic inference that it licenses mass destruction (V36:p007-038). He does not forgive on Rei's or Natsuo's behalf (SH05-SH08). He challenges the Hosu police framing because saving people is hero work (V07:p065). Urgent danger, not settled feeling, decides action against Toya. The model also predicts his overreach: he takes burdens on himself alone until family and peers correct him (V31:p058-062, V36:p039-056). Not A: the V10-V11 covert-rescue decision is recorded through the coalition rather than his own weighing, V31 leaves the lethal or nonlethal method of stopping Toya OPEN, and civic or abstract dilemmas are outside scope. Not C: within the declared domain the evidence shows which consideration decides, not only stated conclusions. This is the grade most worth testing for overgrading.

Only local items: an awkward joke in the V07:p079-080 hospital decompression, literal or deadpan interview behavior (V25), the supplemental author comment qualifying the airhead label (he continues taking words straightforwardly), and the Bakugo lamp report, which the model files under gag and editorial sources (SH-SUP-02, SH-SUP-03). There is no humor policy and no repeated play regime. Not D: the evidence is too thin and largely nonenacted. Not NOT_ASSESSED: located evidence exists and bounds the domain.

The set covers the main arcs from V02 to V42 through dense dated class-ledger deltas and relationship-ledger states, lexical anchors with locators, and a dedicated model of eight atoms, one conditional reconstruction and one probe, with supplemental claims labeled by source class. Not B: fourteen volumes have no Shoto entry and the set does not say whether he is absent there or merely unrecorded; the model is compact; and the vocabulary ledger's broad ranges and historical strings are retrieval aids. Not D: coverage is continuous across every major arc that features him, and the current admissibility corrections leave Shoto's entries untouched apart from bounding V42:p062-064.

Affirmative located limits with page and state: fire use is not reconciliation (V05:p087 against p098-100); unintegrated resentment caused literal blindness toward Inasa (V13:p070); self-reliance underused Momo's judgment until corrected (V08:p019-022); 勝手にしろよ withholds absolution (V18:p173) and public victory does not compel forgiveness (V21:p054-074); the thermal outcome depended on family cooling and Iida's transport (V39:p047-062); V36's victory was not closure (V37:p183-195); Toya's apology is one directed movement, not family-wide reconciliation (V42:p062-064, admissibility correction); burden over-assignment was corrected by Iida (V36:p039-056). The model's REJECT list (fire use as paternal forgiveness; family duty as equal blame) and the supplemental bounds (Inasa's wish is not reciprocity; the lamp motive is guessed) add more. Not A: some items limit reconstruction claims rather than record contradictions, and none is tested by a frozen prediction. Not C: there are more than six independent, located limits. This is the grade most worth testing for overgrading.

Knowledge gates are explicit and located. His own childhood history belongs to him throughout; the class ledger keeps it out of a V03 evidence freeze only because the source discloses it at V04. Toya's identity is unknown until V30:p090-115 and his missing history until V35; V20 ends with pride, forgiveness or rejection OPEN; the method of stopping Toya is OPEN at V31; Phosphor appears in V36 and its victory is not final (V37); the V42:p167 altar implies a later death but does not date it. The model forbids granting the analyst's account of Toya's life to a pre-revelation student and forbids putting adult knowledge of family loss into the V42 hospital encounter. Not A: the adult interval is undated and fourteen volumes lack entries. Not C: the gates are located and enforced by the model and ledgers, including splits inside V05, V13, V30, V31 and V42.

conditions: Use is illustrative reconstruction of a named snapshot, never attributed quotation; any line presented as canon is retrieved from a located page.

Register follows the model's rules for the snapshot and partner: 俺 (僕 only in the V05 childhood memory), compact, direct and literal speech that sharpens into short commands under urgency, pointed distance toward Endeavor, the polite reflective register located toward Rei (V39:p051), and neither affectless delivery nor mechanically appended polite endings.

Content is fixed by the snapshot's knowledge and state (family history, Toya's identity, forgiveness left unresolved); speech functions without a located model (domestic routine, comic banter, romance, adult private disclosure) are not generated, and exact affect is not supplied beyond what the located lines show.
scenario_readiness.note: The evidence constrains generated speech enough for illustrative use. Located lines cover confrontation (クソ親父, そんな屑の道具にはならねえ), exact private disclosure (V04:p092-105), blunt care (なりてえもんちゃんと見ろ, V06:p189), accountability (V13:p070-074), bounded non-absolution (勝手にしろよ, V18:p173), urgent command (V30), forced contact (交わるよ 無理にでも, V36), a reflective theory of conflict (V39:p051) and self-authorship (V42:p066, p168), and the model states register rules. SH-V01 found speech supported while the exact topic was unpredicted, which is productive uncertainty. Not READY: exact-glyph claims must return to the Japanese page, there are few extended exchanges and almost no ordinary-life speech, and family conversation beyond the located lines is thin. Not NOT_READY: the predecessor treated the use bound (illustrative, never quotation) and the ledger's retrieval-aid caveat as findings that generation is unsupported; under the owner rulings they bound use and apply only to the strings named.

conditions: Chronology is one named snapshot from the temporal boundary, stated explicitly and split at the located in-volume changes (V05:p080-085, V13:p059-074, V30:p090-115, V31:p138-141, V36:p007-038, V42:p062-064); his knowledge of Toya's identity and history and the current thermal danger are fixed for it, his own childhood memories belong to him throughout, and later integration, Phosphor and adult reflection are never moved earlier.

The interlocutor is a sampled partner (Endeavor, Rei, Toya, Midoriya, Iida, Momo, Inasa, Bakugo, Class 1-A or the public), handled as the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot, with no forgiveness, reconciliation or family-wide repair assumed.

Transfer to an unsampled comparable partner (another disliked expert offering useful instruction, a peer in resentment-driven tunnel vision, or a family member whose direct exchanges are thin, such as Natsuo or Fuyumi) is a separate, lower-confidence condition that names the sampled relation it extends.

The setting is school training or examination, licensing or remedial work, professional internship or rescue, combat or war, family crisis, or the post-war ordinary approach, with his technical state (refusal, partial integration, regulation, Phosphor) and available support stated.

Output predicts priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels, including family-triggered narrowing and burden over-assignment as live errors; exact affect, comic timing and domestic routine are not predicted, and nothing inherits readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named snapshot, stated explicitly: isolated early student (V02-V04), V05 before or after the p080-085 fire use, after the Sports Festival (V06-V12), V13 before or after the p059-074 self-diagnosis, license failure and renewed professional training (V13:p075 to V29), V30 before or after the p090-115 revelation, V31 before or after the p138-141 shared responsibility, the V35-V39 war states, V42 before or after p062-064, or adulthood. Whether Toya's identity and history are known and the current thermal danger are fixed for that snapshot; his own childhood memories are available at every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Endeavor, Rei, Toya, Midoriya, Iida, Momo, Inasa, Bakugo, Class 1-A peers or the public, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot; Endeavor's professional and paternal roles stay separate and each family member's own boundary is preserved. An unsampled comparable partner is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: School training, examination, licensing or remedial work; professional internship or rescue; combat or war; family crisis; or the post-war ordinary approach
His technical state (right-side-only refusal, partial integration, acquired flame regulation, Phosphor) and available support stated
No forgiveness, family-wide reconciliation or adult private relationship assumed, and no invented domestic routine or romance

scenario_readiness.note: The model's conditional reconstruction (post-internship Shoto: Endeavor offers useful advice while claiming credit for who Shoto has become; Shoto separates technique from ownership, states a boundary and acts on operational need, high confidence for the distinction and medium for its sharpness, with immediate civilian danger suppressing the dispute) supports bounded novel scenes. So does SH-V01's V41 to V42 ordinary-approach prediction, supported on action, motive, speech and relationship handling and partial on emotional trajectory. The probe is retrospective and nonblind, which limits confidence, not the tier. Not READY: transfer beyond the sampled partners and settings is lower confidence and exact affect is not predicted. Not NOT_READY: the evidence states what changes his choice in each sampled relation.

conditions: Setting is a Class 1-A peer exchange, a public or child-facing hero appearance, or a bounded ordinary family approach in a named snapshot.
Literal or sparse responses are read through context and the speaker's actual knowledge, without making him affectless, incapable of irony, or every misunderstanding harmless.
No domestic routine, leisure biography or private adult relationship is invented, and supplemental profile facts constrain without becoming enacted scenes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located peer and public ordinary interaction exists: hospital decompression (V07:p079-080), the corrective repair with Momo (V08:p019-022), resource-sharing with peers (V25:p119-121), the deadpan interview (V25), the food question (V42:p062-064) and the supplemental child-facing ice play and fan attention (SH-SUP-02), with the model's rule that literal reception is read through context. Not READY: there is no discriminating account of his ordinary choices and domestic or private adult life is unseen. Not NOT_READY: bounded peer or public scenes are supported by repeated samples and a stated reception policy.

conditions: The dilemma concerns his own responsibility, family causation, forgiveness or present danger, in a named snapshot after V13 (or after V30 for anything involving Toya).
Asymmetric causal responsibility stays with Endeavor, present responsibility can be shared, and no one's forgiveness is granted on another person's behalf.
Civic, legal or abstract dilemmas, and the lethal or nonlethal method of stopping Toya, are not extrapolated beyond located positions.
scenario_readiness.note: Located reasoning supports bounded responsibility and forgiveness questions through the model's three-part policy (cause, present capacity, each person's own relation): own failure without exemption (V13:p071-074), unequal causal versus shared present responsibility (V31:p138-141), causation without fatalism (V36:p007-038), the duty to save over a procedural framing (V07:p065) and no forgiving on others' behalf. Not READY: the method of stopping Toya is OPEN and civic or abstract dilemmas are outside the evidence. Not NOT_READY: within the domain the deciding consideration is located.
No curated item analyzes romantic interest or behavior, and the model lists private adult relationships as OPEN. This silence is neither evidence of a trait nor of an inability.

conditions: Setting is training, licensing, internship, rescue, combat or adult public service in a named snapshot, with his technical state and available support stated.
Professional use of Endeavor's expertise is not treated as relational reconciliation, and coordination, deference to a stronger plan or accepting help are not treated as submission.
Outcomes that depended on others (family cooling, Iida's transport, coalition support) are not reassigned to his solitary authorship.
scenario_readiness.note: Located professional regimes: the V08 examination repair with Momo, the V10 bounded rescue judgment, the V13 license failure and the V18 remedial course with children, applying the license in public danger (V23:p099-108), the V25-V26 internship and the V26:p071 rescue using acquired flame regulation, the war fronts (V29-V39) and adult public service (V42; SH-SUP-02). Not READY: family cues can still narrow his perception inside professional scenes (V13), and outcomes in the war depended on others. Not NOT_READY: the professional policies (coordination, deference to a stronger plan, technique separated from ownership) are located and repeated.

known_limits.statement: Using fire or Endeavor's technique never signals forgiveness or filial reconciliation: V05:p098-100 (he only forgot Endeavor for an instant) against Endeavor's reading at p087, V21:p054-074 (no forgiveness compelled), V22:p060-062 and V26:p013-016 (technical uptake without relational surrender), and SH-SUP-01's separation of learning from forgiving. The model REJECTs fire use as paternal forgiveness.

A family cue can destabilize otherwise controlled behavior and narrow interpersonal perception: V03:p144-145 and V04:p164-171 under the father's gaze, and V13:p059-074, where resentment produced literal blindness toward Inasa and a license failure. Reconstructions must keep this as a live hazard rather than portraying uniform calm.

The decisive actions against Toya depended on others: Great Glacial Aegir in V39:p047-062 acted on a target the family had already been cooling, after Iida's transport, and V36's immediate victory was not closure (V37:p183-195). Results must not be modeled as Shoto's sole authorship or as a generic power matchup.

Shoto's food question and Toya's apology at V42:p062-064 establish one directed movement between two brothers, not family-wide reconciliation, under the relationship ledger's current admissibility correction. Shoto does not forgive on Rei's or Natsuo's behalf, and his willingness to face Toya does not make him culpable for the childhood conditions.

He tends to take sole responsibility for burdens that action produces or that the family shares: the singular 'I have to deal with Toya' at V31:p058-062 becomes collective at p138-141, and his apology to Iida for heat interference is rejected as unnecessary at V36:p039-056. Close peers and family correct this tendency; it is not a stable solitary-hero policy.

Sparse or literal responses are not an inability to understand emotion. He recognizes Iida's resentment (V06:p184-185), discloses an exact private history once he judges it necessary (V04:p092-105), and in V42 seeks the ordinary conversation that combat could not supply. The author comment in SH-SUP-02 qualifies the airhead label without guaranteeing perfect comprehension, so neither affectless nor fully ironic writing is supported.
No Shoto entry in the curated set covers V01, V12, V14-V17, V19, V24, V27-V28, V32-V33 or V40-V41; behavior in those intervals is not established.
The adult interval, the date of Toya's death implied by the V42:p167 altar, future family contact and private adult relationships are OPEN in the model; ordinary domestic routine is unseen.

The one formal probe (SH-V01) is a retrospective, nonblind chronological holdout on a single family-approach scene. It shows the ordinary-relation policy predicting action, motive, speech and relationship handling, with emotional trajectory partial and the exact topic unpredicted. No frozen prediction tests peer, professional, combat or adult behavior; this limits confidence and permitted use, not the tier.

Exact emotional expression is often unverbalized in the set (the effect of Toya's apology is not verbalized, and SH-V01 rated emotional trajectory partial), and humor rests on a few local items (V07:p079-080, V25, SH-SUP-02, SH-SUP-03) without a play policy. Reconstructions predict choices and priorities, not exact affect or comic timing.
